title: Return leased licenses after user inactivity
summary: Shows how to detect user inactivity in Altium Designer with thread input hooks and a UI-thread timer kept in the shim, and how to return leased licenses with ILicenseManager.ReturnLeasedLicensesOnLogout once the user is idle.
phrasings: release a network license when the user is idle
detect keyboard and mouse inactivity in Altium Designer
run code on a timer on the UI thread from an extension
where to put a Windows hook in a hot-reloaded extension

commands.name: StartAutoRelease
commands.description: Install the input hooks and the idle timer; return the leased licences once per idle period of IdleSeconds (dry run unless DryRun=false)

commands.name: StopAutoRelease
commands.description: Stop the idle timer and remove the input hooks

commands.name: AutoReleaseStatus
commands.description: Report whether the watcher runs, the threshold, seconds since the last input, input events seen, idle triggers and the last result or error

commands.name: ReleaseLicensesNow
commands.description: Call ILicenseManager.ReturnLeasedLicensesOnLogout once and report the licence info before and after (dry run unless DryRun=false)

commands.name: AutoRelease.Idle
commands.description: Run by the shim's timer when the idle threshold is crossed; same work as ReleaseLicensesNow. Not on a menu
